description: Single source of truth for issue #3084 (epic #3077 slice 6). These CI jobs are 'heavy' and must stay self-hosted forever, even once the repository goes public, instead of following the generic hosted-when-public switch (vars.CI_RUNNER_MODE) that light jobs use. tests/test_public_repo_heavy_job_runner_split.py checks every entry against its workflow file; docs/runner-labels.md documents the owner step to scope the runner group named here to this repo and these workflows.
